basis: Complete native captures of RILL code revision 451b7dcc1a34e755751c825d81d4880019cb9023 on 8 November 2026, using the original 32-bar Glass Current session. The source commit records these exact PNGs and the updated README. Only the documented capture harness changes startup/view setup; production rendering and controls are unchanged. Downloads remain rolling alpha builds.
derivatives: Pillow 13.0.0: lossless WebP, method 6, at the native PNG dimensions (2000 × 1250; mixer 2400 × 1250). All six WebP images preserve every source RGB pixel. Social JPEG: proportional Lanczos downsampling of the arrangement to 1600 × 1000, quality 86, optimized. No compositing, retouching or simulated UI.

downloads.note: Each link serves the latest successful main build’s artifact; artifacts are kept for 14 days. These are rolling development builds.
downloads.label: Alpha: the page links rolling main-branch builds, not a stable release.

capture.method: RILL native eframe screenshots on Linux under Xvfb, dark appearance, at 1.25 pixels per point. Complete application content; no UI elements were composited or retouched.
capture.demo: Glass Current: original synthesized audio, four audio tracks, four MIDI tracks, two buses and an Atmosphere volume automation lane; 32 bars at 120 BPM.
capture.instrument: The MIDI tracks are assigned to a genuine locally installed Surge XT 1.3.4 instrument, independently checked through native audio rendering. The plug-in is not bundled with the website or RILL.
capture.setup: Capture-only harness sets window dimensions, fitted timelines, D minor, selected tracks/clips, and a prepared request pinned to the Glass chords / Opening · glass chords MIDI clip. Device startup, discovery and automatic plug-in previews are disabled during capture. No provider credentials, AI request, generated reply or AI song edit is used; Connect AI remains visible.

previous_capture.basis: Native captures of the 6 November main source, using an original 32-bar demo session. Application controls and rendering are unchanged. The download remains a rolling alpha, not a tagged release.
